pages.title: Open Your Aptitudes
pages.text: Press $(k:justlevelingfork.open_aptitudes) to open your aptitude tree.$(br2)Spend earned points on the Strength, Constitution, Agility, and Intelligence paths, or browse the passive perks each level unlocks.$(br2)How points are earned and what each path pays out: $(l:icraft:systems/aptitudes)Aptitudes$(/l).$(br2)$(note)Provided by Iridescent Aptitudes.$()
